text: 财政部：通过“先旧后新”配售开展融资，大股东通过同一离岸信托卖出和买入股票，价格完全一致，且在配售协议签署之日起14日内将新股发行给大股东同一离岸信托的，其卖出股票数量不超过买入股票数量的部分，可不视为转让信托财产，不调整股票财产原值。
text_en: Ministry of Finance: Where financing is carried out through a "top-up placement" (placing existing shares first and subscribing to new shares later), the major shareholder sells and buys shares through the same offshore trust at exactly the same price, and the new shares are issued to the same offshore trust of the major shareholder within 14 days from the date of signing the placing agreement, the portion where the number of shares sold does not exceed the number of shares bought may not be deemed a transfer of trust property, and the original value of the stock property shall not be adjusted.
